title: Cloud compatibility tests: routes, D1/R2 keys, image tags, worker result semantics, cleanup ordering
description: SPEC §12 Phase 0 step 4. Record the current cloud factory's externally observable behavior as tests so Phase 4 can move it without silent drift: HTTP routes and their auth grades, D1 table/key shapes, R2 key layout, image tags and the deployment vars that select model/route, worker RESULT semantics (fallback report, timer push, exit is not proof), and the revoke-before-teardown cleanup ordering. Tests only; no behavior change.
acceptance_criteria: A compatibility test file (or files) under cloud/factory exercises each listed surface against the current implementation and is green; each test names the SPEC section or Appendix A invariant it protects; the suite is registered in the existing factory CI job.
